selection.qualification: Authenticated G2 runtime evidence and controlled reference builds cannot distinguish pristine nanopb 0.4.7, 0.4.8, and 0.4.9. openCFW deliberately selects 0.4.9; this is not proof of the Even Realities vendor point release or checkout.
